I never could understand the fascination of commends, and why people asked to be commended after a game. I mean if I see a play that does an above average perfomance, or a positive attitude through out the match, sure I'll toss one out. But, I won't give one simply due to another player asking for it just because he/she was on the winning team. I mean what am I commending them for, being able to start a Dota match? As for the asking, shouldn't it come unsolicited? I don't know maybe I'm looking at it all wrong.
